name: E-flite S.E.5a 900mm
summary: E-flite foam BNF — 899 mm span, 1.3 kg on 4S 2200 mAh, 3513-1100Kv, 10x5 prop, AS3X+/SAFE.

notes.units: Units: metres, kilograms, newtons, seconds; angles in degrees where the name ends in 'Deg'. 'tuning' holds built-in changes in the Tuning tab's terms (paste an Export's "tuning" here).
notes.about: E-flite S.E.5a 900mm (EFL10950 BNF / EFL10975 PNP), ~1/9 scale foam. Published: span 899 mm, length 716 mm, 1303 g with battery, 3513-1100Kv, 10x5 prop, 45 A ESC, 3S/4S 2200-3200 mAh, CG 72 mm (±5) behind the top-wing leading edge, AS3X+ and SAFE Select. Estimated: wing area (~0.28 m², scale outline), inertia, airfoil and drag figures, thrust curve.
notes.elevatorThrowDeg: 12°: at 16° full up at full power stalled it into a flick roll.
notes.motor: 3513-1100Kv on 4S with a 10x5: ~12,500 rpm loaded, ≈1.25:1 thrust/weight. torqueFactor: motor torque per newton of thrust (m).
notes.gear: Small hard wheels close in front of the CG (axle ~65 mm ahead, about under the top wing's leading edge): they drag and catch on grass, so without up elevator the tail lifts and it noses over, like the real model.
notes.trim: Aileron trim against motor torque at cruise.
notes.upperWingDihedralEffectDeg: The top wing well above the CG acts a little like a high wing.
notes.visualDihedralDeg: As it looks on the model (the flight model uses the same).
